role_evidence.quote: CEST MRI Based Resection of glioblastoma with standard of care adjuvant therpay (temozolomide + radiation therapy)
5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA), a safe FDA approved fluorescence molecule used to increase extent of resection in glioma surgery will be administered for comparision with CEST imaging in surgery.

source_quote.quote: Individuals with suspected, newly diagnosed or recurrent IDH wild type WHO IV glioblastoma

This will be measured through immunohistochemical staning of tumor (via H\&E, anti-EGFR for EGFR amplified tumors), and proliferative tumor (anti-Ki67) which will be reviewed by blinded neuro-pathologist.

coder_notes: Surgical/imaging trial (CEST-EPI MRI-guided resection); no pharmacological candidate. 5-ALA given for fluorescence comparison only (diagnostic_agent; not a registered intervention but stated as administered). Temozolomide is SOC adjuvant therapy in the single arm. Gadolinium contrast for routine MRI not listed (R9). IDH-wildtype is diagnostic (never matched); EGFR IHC is exploratory tissue characterisation; Ki67 treated as routine histology and not recorded.
